fullText:
Introducing QwenGyre, bringing elastic RL to extreme-long-horizon (XLong) agent training. ✨

It launches with two core designs: 🥳
- Elastic Scheduler: reallocates GPUs between rollout & training as demand shifts—live executions never interrupted. Up to 1.85× speedup over Colocate, 1.78× over Async.
- Trajectory Processor: turns branching executions (compaction, sub-agents, retries) into prefix-shared trajectory trees with bounded, deduplicated training samples. Partial progress after timeout still gets scored.

Scaled to Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B with ~700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre lifts NL2RepoBench from 52.5% to 58.5% in 48 steps, cutting end-to-end training time by ~44% vs Async.

fullText:
POWER GRIDS ARE CATL'S NEXT BIG CUSTOMER

I flew out to see CATL open its new battery testing center. 

(The full write up is in my free weekly email, link below.)

CATL is an increasingly important China business. 

It rode the EV wave.

Now it is moving aggressively into energy storage.

1. ENERGY STORAGE IS CATL'S NEXT GROWTH OPPORTUNITY.

Its main product line is TENER, launched in April 2024.

Each 20 foot container holds 6.25 MWh, which CATL says is about 30% higher energy density on a 20% smaller footprint.

2. POWER GRIDS ARE THE BIG USE CASE.

Utilities and grids are 70 to 80% of their installed capacity, with systems starting at 10 MWh.

Batteries respond to demand spikes in seconds while traditional grids take minutes

This matters for AI data centers. 

3. THE GO TO MARKET CHALLENGE IS SLOW CUSTOMERS.

Grid buyers are utilities, independent power producers and transmission operators

so that’s means a longer sales process. 

That is why CATL opened ESVL

which is basically the first fully integrated testing center for battery energy storage systems.

To help reduce the risk for buyers.

***TAKEAWAYS FOR MANAGERS:

→ Ask your sales team which large customers are stalling on risk

then decide what testing or validation proof you could hand them.
